authority: This JSON is the canonical machine-readable roadmap for future P2P development planning. It extends governance/development-control.json (C-line roadmap) and docs/p2p-development/framework/master-roadmap.md (FW-line). On conflict with development-control.json, development-control.json wins for C-line status; this file is authoritative for future planned items and family organization.
ordering_principle: Owner value + dependency necessity + safety maturity + evidence gap + architectural leverage. NOT novelty, NOT recency, NOT 'oldest idea first'.

north_star.statement: P2P hiện làm được gì, đang thiếu gì để đạt mục tiêu 'nói một câu rồi tự xây dự án', tính năng nào đã chọn nhưng chưa làm, đã làm một phần, và cái gì bị chủ động loại bỏ — tất cả trả lời cho người Owner không lập trình.

families.name: Owner Intent & Project Formation
families.purpose: Interpret Owner intent, build Project Constitution/Contract, Product Truth, acceptance criteria, initial architecture, project bootstrap.

families.name: Project Truth & Durable State
families.purpose: State surviving sessions and hosts: task state, execution ledger, evidence-bound completion, recovery.

families.name: Research / Fact / Live-Spec Intelligence
families.purpose: Research intake, fact ledger, live specs, evidence-bound factual authority.

families.name: Context & Retrieval Intelligence
families.purpose: Task-targeted retrieval, progressive disclosure, evidence pointers, deterministic-first, project/repository maps, symbol-aware retrieval, cache-aware context, adaptive context budget, token-bounded maps, current-state capsules.

families.name: Goal Design Intelligence
families.purpose: Design cognition registry, targeted faculty loading, visual recipes as input, design verification — P2P sole router.

families.name: Skills & Knowledge
families.purpose: Skill discovery, progressive loading, provenance, hashing, reverification, rollback, content boundaries; rule sets as loadable units.

families.name: Role / Team / Council Intelligence
families.purpose: Canonical 8-role set, team decision builder, quorum semantics, live council certification.

families.name: Execution Target / Provider / Model Intelligence
families.purpose: Provider-neutral adapter registry, model/provider resolution, quality-adjusted routing, minimum-sufficient host selection.

families.name: Workspace / Session / Worktree Isolation
families.purpose: Task-scoped isolated sessions, git worktrees/workspaces, lease/interruption lifecycle, cold-process recovery.

families.name: Large-Goal Autonomous Execution
families.purpose: One Owner goal -> internal task graph -> bounded autonomous progression -> checkpoint/resume -> Owner Gate only for material decisions; no per-task nagging.

families.name: Quality / Evidence / Evaluation
families.purpose: Evaluation suites, negative tests, regression contracts, outcome learning, evidence-based iteration; AI execution reliability guards.

families.name: Owner Experience / Decision Trace
families.purpose: Native decision trace per step, owner summaries, beginner output simplicity, code-impact evidence contract (pending).

families.name: Safety / Authority / Permissions
families.purpose: Bounded documentation mutation, permission envelopes, A-E fail classification, second-path prewrite guard, rejected-pattern register.

families.name: Mutation Capability Ladder
families.purpose: Ordered mutation levels, each with own authority, evidence, verification, rollback, and Owner policy.

families.name: Resilience / Recovery / Failover
families.purpose: Checkpoint/resume, lease interruption, fresh-tree recovery, drift fail-closed semantics.

families.name: UI / UX / Visual Intelligence
families.purpose: Design cognition and visual-recipe input to C13 lineage; beginner-first visual guidance; never a second router.

families.name: Obsolescence / Capability Drift
families.purpose: Drift fail-closed policy, stale-claim expiration, capability evidence revalidation, vendor-displacement survival.

families.name: Release / Install / Project Lifecycle
families.purpose: Release gates, installation/doctor/activation/rollback on real projects, promotion machinery.

items.title: Controlled continuation
items.owner_value: Resume interrupted work without full restart — beginner impact: less manual state rebuild.
items.target_evidence: C08 contract with checkpoint/resume acceptance bar
items.defer_reason: Explicit Owner deferral; superseded in sequencing by lifecycle/foundation goals

items.title: Live host identity and event boundary

dependencies: host availability with required evidence keys
items.target_evidence: live host identity receipt + event boundary evidence
items.next_safe_when: evidence keys available on target host
items.defer_reason: BLOCKED / EVENT_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE — missing real-world evidence, not design

items.title: Live host evidence completion
items.owner_value: Same family as C09 — production trustworthiness.
items.target_evidence: live host capability evidence on real runtime

items.title: Controlled Execution Hardening
items.owner_value: Thắt chặt kiểm soát thực thi, ngăn chặn các hành động không được phép.

items.title: AI Execution Reliability Guard
items.owner_value: Ngăn chặn tin tưởng mù quáng vào AI, yêu cầu bằng chứng thực thi.
